labor_compensation.label: Labor compensation
labor_compensation.description: Compensation of employees for the corporate sector.

taxes_total.label: Total taxes
taxes_total.description: Indirect business taxes, transfers, and corporate taxes.

net_investment.label: Net investment
net_investment.description: Gross investment minus consumption of fixed capital.

fcf.label: Free cash flow
fcf.description: Gross value added less labor, taxes, and gross investment.

earnings.label: Earnings
earnings.description: Free cash flow plus net investment.

enterprise_value.label: Enterprise value
enterprise_value.description: Corporate enterprise value following the AHP definition.

capital_replacement_cost.label: Capital replacement cost
capital_replacement_cost.description: Current-cost replacement value of fixed corporate assets.

fcf_yield.label: Free cash flow yield
fcf_yield.description: Free cash flow divided by enterprise value.

ev_gva.label: EV / GVA
ev_gva.description: Enterprise value divided by gross value added.

k_gva.label: K / GVA
k_gva.description: Capital replacement cost divided by gross value added.

fcf_gva.label: FCF / GVA
fcf_gva.description: Free cash flow divided by gross value added.

labor_share.label: Labor share
labor_share.description: Labor compensation divided by gross value added.

net_inv_v.label: Net investment / V
net_inv_v.description: Net investment divided by enterprise value.

net_inv_k.label: Net investment / K
net_inv_k.description: Net investment divided by capital replacement cost.

k_v.label: K / V
k_v.description: Capital replacement cost divided by enterprise value.

payout_ratio.label: Payout ratio
payout_ratio.description: Free cash flow divided by earnings.
